platform.restart: Virtual box 1 (in the api process) started about 02:30:06-02:30:14Z, after the 02:29:00 deploy went live; four printouts reads during the first wait of step 1a answered 409 BOX_NOT_IN_PROCESS; every proved step ran after it. Uptime 600 s at 02:40:06Z and 1440 s at 02:54:14Z: no restart through the end of the run (02:52:58Z).
platform.end: At 02:53Z all three services had a new automatic build in progress at 1b9885a32 (Render redeploying after the checks); the live deploys were unchanged.

hunt: A ZZ TEST till changed into a Customer display in the Console keeps its code prefix (Z97102, still shown on its card) and its two printer assignments (receipt, dropoff_band), neither of which its form shows or can clear; a new ZZ TEST till asking for Z97102 is refused 409 STATION_CODE_PREFIX_TAKEN. apps/console/src/components/devices/StationDrawer.tsx:167-170 (devices from the till assignments and filled.codePrefix sent back for a kind that uses neither). Pictures h2a-h2d.

Add a device through the Console form writes settings nobody chose: a receipt printer gets {escpos:{dotsPerLine:576}}, a band printer {label:{sensing:gap}} (the Edit form no longer does). apps/console/src/components/devices/BoxDrawer.tsx:880-886. Pictures h3a-h3c.

The closed Printer it comes out of field, half the drawer wide, cuts the chosen entry to ZZ TEST 971 band printer · Drop (the job name the fix adds is clipped; the open list shows it whole). The Paper width field takes the whole row for the same reason (BoxDrawer.tsx:680 sm:col-span-2); the printer field does not (apps/console/src/components/devices/BoxDrawer.tsx:1333-1342). Picture 02b1.

A Thai station name on the test page: the Station row ink ends 1 dot above the Box row (139 -> 141 on the receipt page, 185 -> 187 on the band page) against 9-10 dots with a Latin name; the value sits about 5 dots lower than its label. packages/print/src/layout/layout.ts:427 (with a leading, a line taller than it steps ascent+descent with no gap) with the SCRUM-971 rowDots of packages/print/src/templates/test-page.ts:82,93. Rows do not overlap. Pictures h1b, h1c.

The band page (400 dots) wraps the Thai station name inside the word ญี่ปุ่น (ญี่ / ปุ่น): the documented rule of packages/print/src/layout/wrap.ts:4-18 (no dictionary breaker by default). Picture h1b.

The Controls picker with a printer doing one job only names the printer alone (ZZ TEST 971 band printer), without its job (drop-off): by design (stationPrinters.ts printerChoices). Test print still asked for dropoff_band. Picture h1a.
Band test pages on the kids and adults roles with the park settings: 200 x 591 dots, the same page as the drop-off role. Pictures 04c, 04d.
End of Day saved list: no day in the 21 before 13 Nov is closed at Central Floresta, so no saved list exists to read; Close Day was not pressed. Picture h5.

Small: the station drawer says Saving bumps the config version but an unchanged display saved at v1 stayed v1 (picture 05f/05h); End of Day Counts outstanding shows Over/short ฿0 with Actual ฿0 while the cash card says awaiting count (picture h4a); the band printer simulator restarts its printout numbering at #1 when its label settings change (point 4 printouts #1-#3 then #1).
